name: Help
overview: Scripture reveals that God is the ultimate helper who strengthens, protects, and fights on behalf of His people, as seen in verses like Exodus 14:14 and Psalms 54:4. Believers are encouraged to trust and commit their ways to the Lord, confident that He hears their cries and delivers them from trouble (Psalms 34:17, 37:5). God's help not only sustains through difficult times but also empowers His followers to assist others, reflecting His presence with those who uphold one another (Psalms 118:7, 28:7).
